resources.string: A young girl with immense fire magic and her bear Tibbers.
Annie is a dangerous child mage whose volatile pyromancy belies a still, calculating mind. Her closest companion is Tibbers, a magically forged bear who responds to her rage and protectiveness.
After casting a certain number of spells, Annie\'s next offensive spell will stun the target and summon extra fury.
Every 4 spells: next spell stuns for 1.75s
Annie launches a concentrated fireball that deals magic damage to a single target. If it kills the target, its cooldown is refunded.
Annie unleashes a cone of flame that scorches enemies in front of her for magic damage.
Annie surrounds herself with a shield that reduces incoming damage and retaliates against attackers.
Annie summons Tibbers to burn enemies in an area and fight at her side until dismissed.
Summons Tibbers; damage scales by level
A warrior of the moon who defies the sun’s order.
Diana draws power from the moon itself. Driven by a fierce conviction, she challenges ancient orders and channels lunar energy to cleave through enemies and fate alike.
Diana\'s spells empower her attacks, causing bonus damage after spellcasts and enhancing her burst potential.
Diana throws a crescent-shaped blade that deals magic damage to enemies hit in a line.
Diana creates orbiting spheres that explode around her, dealing damage and granting a temporary shield.
Diana dashes to a target, dealing magic damage and refreshing if the target was recently struck by her abilities.
Diana calls down a gravitational pull that slows and damages enemies, amplifying her follow-up attacks.
A mischievous sea dweller who thrives in the ocean depths.
Fizz is a nimble sea sprite, equal parts prankster and predator. He uses agility and trickery to outmaneuver foes, turning tides with sudden bursts of feral power.
Fizz\'s agility allows him to move through units and deal bonus on-hit magic damage under certain conditions.
Fizz rushes forward, striking his target and applying on-hit effects. He can use this to close gaps quickly.
Fizz\'s attacks deal bonus magic damage and enhance his next strike with additional effects.
Fizz hops onto his trident to become untargetable, then slams down to damage and slow enemies in an area.
Fizz launches a fish that attaches to the first champion hit; after a delay, sharks appear and deal massive damage.
A master of blade dancing and defender of Ionia.
Irelia is a graceful but lethal defender of her homeland. She dances with razor-sharp blades, combining precision and fluid motion to dominate any battlefield.
Irelia gains attack speed and bonus damage from stacking her passive through ability hits.
Irelia lunges to a target, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects; resets if it kills the target.
Irelia channels and then strikes, reducing incoming damage and dealing a powerful counterattack.
Irelia sends blades that converge on a location, stunning enemies they hit between them.
Irelia launches a blade barrage that marks and damages enemies while creating a deadly field of blades.
A solar warrior wielding the shield and sword of the Solari.
Leona is a stalwart solar guardian. Her armor and shield shine with celestial light, allowing her to lead the charge and lock enemies down for her allies.
Leona\'s basic attacks mark enemies with Sunlight; allied attacks detonate the mark to deal bonus damage.
Leona stabs her shield at an enemy, dealing damage and briefly stunning them.
Leona raises a shield of sunlight, gaining armor and magic resist and damaging nearby enemies when it expires.
Leona projects a solar blade that tethers to the last enemy champion struck and dashes to them.
Leona calls down a beam of solar energy that slows and stuns enemies in the area.
An armored revenant who commands both death and souls.
Mordekaiser is a towering warlord forged in iron and malice. His mastery over death and souls grants him an unearthly presence that crushes resistance and reshapes battlefields.
Mordekaiser converts portions of damage dealt into an extra resource or shield, empowering his presence in fights.
Mordekaiser slams his mace down, dealing heavy damage to a single target or in an area depending on hit location.
Mordekaiser gains a shield and can consume part of it to restore health when he deals damage.
Mordekaiser pulls enemies toward a point, dealing damage and disrupting their positioning.
Mordekaiser banishes an enemy to the Death Realm, isolating them and fighting one-on-one with increased power.
A chameleon vastaya with the power to mimic others.
Neeko is playful and inquisitive, able to mimic friends and foes. She uses illusion and surprise to sow confusion, then punishes the disoriented with powerful magic.
Neeko can disguise herself as allied champions and gains bonus effects on her next attack after casting spells.
Neeko fires a projectile that explodes and then can detonate again, dealing magic damage in an area.
Neeko temporarily becomes invisible and empowers her next attack with extra damage and effects.
Neeko throws a spiral that roots and damages enemy champions hit at the end of its path.
Neeko leaps into the air and detonates, dealing massive area damage and stunning enemies around her.
A fighter cursed by the Mist, carrying light against darkness.
Senna is a light-bearer who turned her curse into a weapon. She fights across great distances, cleansing the mist and liberating the lost with her spectral artillery.
Senna collects Mist Wraiths from killed enemies, increasing her attack range and damage over time.
Senna fires a long beam that damages enemies and heals allies it passes through.
Senna fires a missile that stuns the first enemy champion struck after a short delay, dealing magic damage.
Senna shrouds allies in mist, granting camouflage and movement advantages while shielding them from targeting.
Senna unleashes a global beam that damages enemies and shields allies across great distances.
The protector of Valoran, blessed with celestial power.
Taric is the guardian of beauty and resilience, his gem-forged magic mending and shielding allies while smiting those who threaten the balance of life.
Taric\'s empowered attacks grant bonus effects and reduce his basic attack cooldown, supporting sustained defense.
Taric calls down a burst of starlight, healing nearby allies and damaging enemies in a small area.
Taric grants an ally a protective aura that enhances their defenses and links Taric to them.
Taric fires a line of starlight that stuns the first enemy hit after a short delay when empowered.
Taric calls down a celestial blessing that, after a short delay, makes allied champions invulnerable for a brief period.
A fast scout from Bandle City, expert in stealth and traps.
Teemo is a deceptively cheerful scout whose expertise in stealth and traps makes him one of the deadliest hidden threats on the field. Never turn your back on a mushroomed lane.
Teemo can stealth when standing still for a short time; his attacks from stealth deal bonus damage.
Teemo shoots a dart that blinds the target, causing their basic attacks to miss for a short duration.
Teemo passively gains attack speed and can activate Move Quick for a burst of movement speed.
Teemo\'s attacks poison enemies, dealing damage over time with each successful hit.
Teemo plants hidden mushroom traps that explode when enemies approach, dealing damage and applying effects.
A tough enforcer from Piltover with mechanical gauntlets.
Vi is a relentless brawler with a heart for justice. Her powered gauntlets pulverize defenses and create openings where none existed before.
Vi\'s attacks charge a shield that can absorb damage; her spells often empower a follow-up strike.
Vi charges a powerful forward punch that knocks back and damages enemies when released.
Vi\'s punches break through defenses, dealing increased damage the more she hits the same target.
Vi\'s next attack deals bonus area damage, cleaving nearby enemies with mechanical force.
Vi charges at an enemy champion, suppressing and damaging them while knocking aside anyone in her path.
A yordle who loves bombs, chaos, and blowing things up.
Ziggs is a manic explosives expert who treats the battlefield like a playground. Precision or chaos—either way, everything ends in a spectacular boom.
Ziggs gains increased ability power from destroying towers and builds explosive combos over time.
Ziggs throws a bomb that bounces, dealing magic damage to the first enemy struck and nearby targets.
Ziggs places a charge that can be detonated to damage and displace enemies or destroy terrain.
Ziggs scatters explosive mines that slow and damage enemies who cross them.
Ziggs lobs a massive bomb that deals huge area magic damage, ideal for sieging or finishing fights.
